verdict.rationale: The evidence shows dlt/dltHub equipping external, general-purpose coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) through the AI Harness's skills, rules, and MCP servers. It does not show an AI assistant built into dlt or dltHub to which users delegate tasks. Marketing lines such as "agents doing the work on infra we run" never describe an in-product assistant. Supporting third-party agents is an adjacent capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
